npcs.name: Apothecary Lin
npcs.title: Herbalist
npcs.greeting: Careful where you step in the eastern woods, friend.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: The Light keep you. Even the dead find no rest here of late.

npcs.name: Bursar Fernando
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the Gilded Strongbox. Your goods rest safe behind our locks.

npcs.name: Card Master
npcs.title: Dealer of Chance
npcs.greeting: Care for a Card Duel? Best of three, winner takes the bragging rights.

npcs.name: Cook Marlow
npcs.title: Master of the Kitchens
npcs.greeting: Nothing leaves my kitchens half-cooked, friend. Sit, eat, then get back out there.

npcs.name: Fisherman Brandt
npcs.title: Old Salt
npcs.greeting: Blrb-glub— sorry, been listening to those fish-men too long.

npcs.name: Foreman Odell
npcs.title: Mine Foreman
npcs.greeting: Whole dig's crawling with those dirt-caked vermin!

npcs.name: Forgemistress Darva
npcs.title: Master of the Forge
npcs.greeting: The forge answers to me, friend. Bring good ore and it will answer to you too.

npcs.name: Groundskeeper Bram
npcs.title: Keeper of the Sowfield
npcs.greeting: The truce holds at the Sowfield, friend: boots and shoulders only. Care to play for the Copper Pail?

npcs.name: Marshal Redbrook
npcs.title: Town Marshal
npcs.greeting: Keep your blade close, friend. The Vale is not what it was.

npcs.name: Saul the Chronicler
npcs.title: The Vale Chronicle
npcs.greeting: Every deed worth doing is worth writing down twice, you: once for the ledger and once for the fireside.

npcs.name: Smith Haldren
npcs.title: Armorer & Weaponsmith
npcs.greeting: Mind the sparks, friend. Good steel is the difference between a scar and a grave.

npcs.name: The Merchant
npcs.title: Keeper of the World Market
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the World Market, friend. Buy from every adventurer in the realm — or set out your own wares and let coin find you.

npcs.name: Tinker Gizzel
npcs.title: Master of the Toolworks
npcs.greeting: Springs, sprockets, and sharp edges, friend: the toolworks has whatever your hands lack.

npcs.name: Trader Wilkes
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Fresh bread, clean water, fair prices. What can I get you?

npcs.name: Weaver Ottilie
npcs.title: Master of the Loom
npcs.greeting: Mind the threads, friend. A steady hand at the loom beats a strong one.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: The Light keep you above the water, you. The dead in this fen do not sleep — they wade.

npcs.name: Bursar Petra Vell
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: The Gilded Strongbox keeps clean ledgers and cleaner vaults. What shall we stow for you?

npcs.name: Chronicler Osric Fenn
npcs.title: The Marsh Chronicle
npcs.greeting: Mind the damp on the pages, you. The fen eats more books than readers ever will.

npcs.name: Herbalist Yara
npcs.title: Herbalist
npcs.greeting: Mind the thicket west of the road. The webs are thick as sailcloth this season.

npcs.name: Provisioner Hale
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Dry boots, dry bread, dry powder — at Fenbridge you get two of the three on a good day.

npcs.name: Scout Maren
npcs.title: Marshal's Scout
npcs.greeting: Quiet feet and a short blade keep you breathing out here. Speak quick — I am due back in the reeds.

npcs.name: Tanner Hesk
npcs.title: Master of the Tannery
npcs.greeting: A hide is only as good as its tanning, friend. The vats are ready when you are.

npcs.name: Warden Fenwick
npcs.title: Warden of Fenbridge
npcs.greeting: Hold at the gate, friend. Past those reeds, the fen does the killing for us.

npcs.name: Ferrymaster Caddow
npcs.title: Keeper of the Lantern Ferries
npcs.greeting: Fog is on the Mere again. When the lanterns go out on the water, wise folk stay ashore.

npcs.name: Orchardist Pomeline
npcs.title: Keeper of the Gilded Rows
npcs.greeting: Mind where you step. Every root in these rows is older than the town, and they remember.

npcs.name: Reeve Ottoline
npcs.title: Reeve of Lanternmere
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Lanternmere, where the harvest never ends and neither does the work.

npcs.name: Waywatcher Sorrel
npcs.title: Watcher of the Goldmelt
npcs.greeting: Snow behind you, gold ahead. Few walk the Goldmelt twice, so make the crossing count.

npcs.name: Gatecaptain Brannoc
npcs.title: Commander of Wyrmwatch
npcs.greeting: Wyrmwatch holds the gate. Has held it forty years. It will hold it tonight.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Sela
npcs.title: Keeper of the Garrison Stores
npcs.greeting: Every crate in this yard crossed forty miles of ash to get here. Treat them kindly.

npcs.name: Scout Yerrin
npcs.title: Far-Dune Watcher
npcs.greeting: Keep low. Sound carries strangely off the glass, and the gate below has ears.

npcs.name: Ondrel Vane
npcs.title: Tidewatcher
npcs.greeting: The mere drinks the moonlight, friend, and gives back the drowned. I have watched that gate for thirty nights — and tonight it is open.

npcs.name: Gardener Yew
npcs.title: The Last Gardener
npcs.greeting: Hand me that barrow, would you? These lawns do not walk themselves, whatever the hamlet thinks.

quests.name: The Bull of the Fountain Court

npcs.name: Gatewarden Pell
npcs.title: Keeper of the Garden Gate
npcs.greeting: Mind how you go on the lawns. The garden keeps them trimmed, and it likes them tidy.

npcs.name: Head Gardener Amaranth
npcs.title: Head Gardener of the Evergarden
npcs.greeting: Do not mind the shadows under my eyes. Someone has to stay awake while the garden dreams.

npcs.name: Wickmother Sorrel
npcs.title: Keeper of the Hedgewick Inn
npcs.greeting: Come in, sit, there is cordial on the fire. Just keep a hand on anything iron: the gnomes are light-fingered of late.

npcs.name: Bellkeeper Tam
npcs.title: Watchbell Keeper
npcs.greeting: The bell is the only warning the breaks give us, friend. One toll for the fields, two for the cliffs, three when it is close enough that running will not help. Keep an ear on it, and it may keep you whole.

npcs.name: Frightened Nell
npcs.title: Gullhaven Fisher
npcs.greeting: It opened right where the nets dry. Right there, where I stood every morning of my life. I do not go down to the shore anymore. I do not go much of anywhere anymore.

npcs.name: Mender Saul
npcs.title: Field Surgeon
npcs.greeting: I have set more bones this one month than in ten years of mending fishing falls. The breaks do not leave much of what they take. Come back to me whole, if you can manage it.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Edda
npcs.title: Redoubt Armorer
npcs.greeting: Steel and salt, friend, it is all I have left to hand out. Take it and make the breaks regret opening where I could reach them.

npcs.name: Riftwatch Ollun
npcs.title: Breach Scholar
npcs.greeting: Every break sings before it opens, if you have the ear for it. I can hear three of them stirring on the island right now, and one of them is close.

npcs.name: Warden Coalfast
npcs.title: Redoubt Commander
npcs.greeting: The breaks do not care that Gullhaven is small, friend. We hold this shore, or there is no shore left to hold. Stand with us and I will not forget it.

npcs.name: Aurorist Veyla
npcs.title: Reader of the Lights
npcs.greeting: Hush. The lights are speaking tonight, and they do not repeat themselves.

npcs.name: Hearthkeeper Maeve
npcs.title: Keeper of the Hearth-Lodge
npcs.greeting: Come in off the cold. The lodge fire never goes out, so long as I draw breath.

npcs.name: Scout Einna
npcs.title: Snowline Scout
npcs.greeting: You walked the pass alive. Good. Icemantle should hear of it.

npcs.name: Trapper Brosk
npcs.title: Shiverfen Trapper
npcs.greeting: Fen took three of my lines this week. Fen never took a line in twenty years.

npcs.name: Warden Kaldra
npcs.title: Warden of Icemantle
npcs.greeting: Mind the benches, stranger. The snow keeps what it takes.

npcs.name: Harbormaster Odile
npcs.title: Harbormaster of Wickharbor
npcs.greeting: Every boat in this cove owes the Old Beacon its keel. Speak quick, the tide will not wait.

npcs.name: Keeper Bram
npcs.title: Keeper of the Old Beacon
npcs.greeting: Nine and thirty years this lamp has burned on my watch. It will not go dark on yours.

npcs.name: Salvager Edda
npcs.title: Wreckfield Salvager
npcs.greeting: Wreckwood, rope, and dead men's cargo. The sea pays my wage, when the Warden lets it.

npcs.name: Watcher Maren
npcs.title: The Windway Watch
npcs.greeting: Mind your footing past the gate. The wind up here takes hats first and questions never.

npcs.name: Astronomer Cassian
npcs.title: Watcher at the Vigil
npcs.greeting: Hush now. The sky never dawns here, so it never stops talking either.

npcs.name: Lamplighter Sorrel
npcs.title: Keeper of the Nightgate
npcs.greeting: Mind the lamps, friend. Past this gate the sun gives up and the flowers take over.

npcs.name: Lira Dewsong
npcs.title: Night-Gardener of Moonrest
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Moonrest, where the flowers do our dawning for us.

npcs.name: Weaver Amelle
npcs.title: Moonfleece Weaver
npcs.greeting: Feel that? Moonfleece on the loom. Warmer than any fire you have sat beside.

npcs.name: Okku
npcs.title: The Man Who Went In
npcs.greeting: Quiet now. The drums count everything that walks under the trees, and they have already counted you.

npcs.name: Pearl-Mother Isha
npcs.title: Elder of the Divers
npcs.greeting: The sea gives, the sand keeps, and the jungle takes. Stay on the strand, stranger.

npcs.name: Salvage-Boss Ryna
npcs.title: Mistress of the Wreck Line
npcs.greeting: A friend with working arms, good. The wreck line pays well, if the crabs leave you enough fingers to count it.

npcs.name: Strandwatcher Pell
npcs.title: Watcher of the Tanglemouth
npcs.greeting: Out of the black trees at last. Breathe, stranger, the sun holds this side of the pass.

npcs.name: Archivist Tullo
npcs.title: Reader of Stones
npcs.greeting: The monuments out there have not spoken to anyone in an age. Perhaps they were waiting for fresh ears.

npcs.name: Huntsman Deral
npcs.title: Warden of the Herds
npcs.greeting: Quiet now. The herd knows every sound this valley makes, and so do I.

quests.name: The Old Shell of the Shallows

npcs.name: Keeper Saelwyn
npcs.title: Keeper of the Hollow
npcs.greeting: Few of your kind have stood beneath these boughs, friend. Walk gently, and be welcome.

npcs.name: Loremother Bryn
npcs.title: Voice of the Shrine
npcs.greeting: Every light in this valley remembers something, you. Help me listen.

npcs.name: Provisioner Fenna
npcs.title: Eldergleam Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Bread still warm, water still sweet. The Hollow provides, and so do I.

npcs.name: Wardsmith Orun
npcs.title: Keeper of the Old Forges
npcs.greeting: These forges cooled centuries ago, friend, but their work still holds an edge.

npcs.name: Bridgewright Alden
npcs.title: Master of the Fenway
npcs.greeting: Every plank in this town is mine to keep, and the fen chews on all of them.

npcs.name: Mother Sedge
npcs.title: Fen-Witch of Willowweep
npcs.greeting: The willows told me you were coming before your boots left the bridge.

npcs.name: Netter Maris
npcs.title: Eel-Netter of Bridgemere
npcs.greeting: Smell that? Smoked eel. Half this town stands on stilts I bought with it.

npcs.name: Waykeeper Pell
npcs.title: Keeper of the Amberfen Steps
npcs.greeting: Down the Steps and into the soft country. Mind where you plant your boots.

npcs.name: Lampman Cobb
npcs.title: Keeper of the Crowgate Lanterns
npcs.greeting: Stay in the lamplight, friend. The wood counts everyone who passes the gate.

npcs.name: Sexton Marrow
npcs.title: Sexton of Gallowmere
npcs.greeting: We bury them deep here, and we ring the bells so they remember to stay down.

npcs.name: Vicar Creel
npcs.title: Last Vicar of the Mournstone
npcs.greeting: The chapel fell years ago. The dead beneath it did not notice, and so I stayed.

npcs.name: Widow Tansy
npcs.title: Candlewright of Gallowmere
npcs.greeting: A candle for every grave, and not one may go out. Not one, do you hear me?

npcs.name: Alchemist Verane
npcs.title: Master of the Apothecary
npcs.greeting: Measure twice and pour once, friend. The apothecary has no patience for spilled reagents.

npcs.name: Armorer Hode
npcs.title: Master Armorer
npcs.greeting: Forge is hot and the grindstone is turning. If it cuts, I sell it.

npcs.name: Auctioneer Voss
npcs.title: Keeper of the World Market
npcs.greeting: The World Market is open here too, friend. Buy from every adventurer in the realm, or set out your own wares.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: From a chapel yard in the Vale to the roof of the world... the trail we have followed ends here. I can feel the mountain listening.

npcs.name: Brother Aldric
npcs.title: Priest of the Vale
npcs.greeting: From a chapel yard in the Vale to the roof of the world... the trail we have followed ends here. I can feel the mountain listening.

npcs.name: Bursar Aldous Crane
npcs.title: The Gilded Strongbox
npcs.greeting: Every crate, coffer, and trinket is safe with the Gilded Strongbox.

npcs.name: Captain Thessaly
npcs.title: Highwatch Captain
npcs.greeting: Two hundred years this wall has held, friend. It will not break on my watch — but it groans.

npcs.name: Chronicler Zenzie
npcs.title: The Peaks Chronicle
npcs.greeting: The mountain forgets nothing, you, and neither do I. Let us see what you have done.

npcs.name: Loremaster Caddis
npcs.title: Loremaster
npcs.greeting: Mind the loose shale, friend. The mountain has been... restless of late. I intend to learn why.

npcs.name: Marla Hitchen
npcs.title: Stablemaster
npcs.greeting: Every rider walks in on two legs, friend. I will not hand you the reins until you can sit the Valorsteed without kissing the dirt, and the Galecrest wind shows no mercy to a bad seat.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Bree
npcs.title: Highwatch Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Wool, hardtack, and steel-shod boots — Highwatch runs on all three, and I am short of everything.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Vex
npcs.title: Heroic Quartermaster
npcs.greeting: Proof of the heroic depths buys the finest rings and pendants in Highwatch. Show me your marks.

npcs.name: Scout Maren
npcs.title: Marshal's Scout
npcs.greeting: I tracked cultists through the fen at your side, and the trail led here. The peaks are worse, friend. Stay sharp.

npcs.name: Warmarshal Draven Kole
npcs.title: Master of the Warfare Stores
npcs.greeting: Honor is the only coin I take, and the Warfare stores are mine to guard. Earn your rank on the field and I will armor you for the next one.
